# BabyRock

> BabyRock looks after a local business's Google profile. Its AI assistant, Rosalia, works from the owner's WhatsApp: she replies to Google reviews, suggests what to post each week and on special dates, prepares photos from the owner's own pictures, and keeps opening hours and the WhatsApp link up to date. The owner stays in control: difficult reviews are approved by WhatsApp before anything goes live.

BabyRock is aimed at owners of shops, restaurants, salons and other local businesses with a Google Business Profile. The main market today is Mexico (Spanish, with Mexican wording); the English pages serve other markets.

## What BabyRock does
- Replies to Google reviews in the language of the customer. Good reviews are answered automatically; delicate ones (1 to 3 stars) wait for the owner's OK by WhatsApp.
- Suggests what to post each week and on special dates, and writes Google posts for the owner to approve.
- Prepares new photos from the owner's own pictures, ready for Google.
- Keeps the profile in order: opening hours, holidays, phone number and WhatsApp link, with suggestions for what is missing.
- Rosalia is an AI assistant, available 24/7 on WhatsApp.

## Plans
- Free plan: 10 review replies a month, no card needed.
- Plan Mini: MX$99 a month in Mexico (plus IVA where shown on the pricing page). Up to 100 review replies, 4 Google posts and 4 photos a month, plus profile care.
- Prices differ by country; the pricing page shows the price for the visitor's country.
